title.en: An Act Creating the Municipality of Placer in the Province of Masbate

text.en: The barrio of Placer in the municipality of Cataignan, Province of Masbate, is separated from the municipality and constituted into a new municipality to be known as the municipality of Placer.
The elective officials of the new municipality shall be appointed by the President of the Philippines and shall hold office until their successors shall have been elected and qualified.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1948.
